verdict.summary_en: Korean delivery note DN-260910-656 dated 2026.09.10 from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, against PO 4500318713. It lists one line, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 11 000 PCS in 11 boxes, 99 kg total, carried by Nordhav Shipping A/S. A blue stamp reads RECEIVED 19.10.2026 DC-HAM. There are no handwritten corrections or strike-throughs, and the remarks field is empty.
red_flags: The receiver (인수자) signature line is blank. Only the DC-HAM received stamp confirms receipt.
The note shows only the delivered quantity. It has no ordered quantity to compare against, so a short or over delivery can't be checked from this document.
The received stamp date (19.10.2026) is about 40 days after the note date (2026.09.10).
observations: The red round company seal (HWASEONG MEMORY CO LTD, with a star) overlaps the unit cell (PCS) and the box-count cell (11) in the table, and touches the end of the quantity 11 000. The values are still readable. The box count matches the '박스: 11' line below the table.
The blue RECEIVED stamp is rectangular and slightly tilted. It is clear.
The receiver signature line is empty, and so is the remarks (비고) field.
The quantity is written with a space as the thousands separator: '11 000'.
No prices appear on the note.
The page is clean, with no visible damage.
